text:
Hannah (Finance Ops): FYI reseller 'SkyMesh' flagged mismatch in AWS settlement: partner changed SKU code in AWS Partner Portal mid-cycle and marketplace export has both old and new SKUs billed for same seats. Customer asked for correction.

Luis (Partner Ops): Yikes. Do we have the export rows? which SKU codes?

Hannah (Finance Ops): CSV excerpt:

```
subscription_id,sku_code,seat_count,unit_price,report_date
sub_sm01,aws-skymesh-pro-v1,120,8.00,2024-12-01
sub_sm01,aws-skymesh-pro,120,8.00,2024-12-15
```

Partner renamed sku from "aws-skymesh-pro-v1" to "aws-skymesh-pro" on 2024-12-15 (mid-period). Export included both rows and AWS billed both lines -> duplicate charge of 120 seats * $8 = $960 gross.

Owen (Revenue Ops): Confirming this is a partner-side SKU rename; remediation options: (A) request AWS amended settlement (can take multiple cycles), or (B) issue provisional credit to reseller/customer and reclaim if AWS reimburses. Director signoff required for >$500.

Keisha (Accounting): $960 > $500 so we need Director approval. JE lines required: reverse revenue $960 DR, reverse commission accrual (partner commission 20% -> $192 CR), record marketplace withholding payable (AWS 12% -> $115.20 CR). Also need original invoice id and settlement id to attach.

Billing Bot: Created ticket FIN-5268: "AWS SKU rename duplicate billing - SkyMesh". Assigned to @keisha and @hannah.

Luis (Partner Ops): Partner claims rename was admin error; they've provided portal change logs and asked for a single consolidated credit. I'll attach portal audit and partner-signed acceptance to the ticket.

Nora (Revenue Director): Approve provisional credit up to $1,000 to resolve customer pain, provided we include reclaim clause if AWS reimburses Redwood. CC accounting@redwood.com on the credit memo.

Hannah (Finance Ops): Drafting provisional credit memo CM-5268-P for $960 gross. Withholding 12% = $115.20, net credit $844.80. Commission reversal $192. Will include reclaim clause: "If AWS issues reimbursement within 90 days, Redwood will reclaim the provisional credit from partner."

Keisha (Accounting): OK to post provisional CM once partner acceptance and original invoice (INV-AWS-20241201-SM) attached. I'll prepare the JE and ensure GL rounding per policy.

Luis (Partner Ops): Uploading partner acceptance and portal audit to FIN-5268. Escalating with AWS partner billing for amended settlement ref AZ-CASE-xxxxx.

Billing Bot: FIN-5268 status -> "provisional credit pending accounting post".

Owen (Revenue Ops): After posting, we should add subscription tag "sku-rename-guardrail" and route to eng to add a check in export pipeline to dedupe identical subscription+period SKUs. @eng-sre please watch FIN-5268.

Hannah (Finance Ops): Posting provisional CM-5268-P now and tagging FIN-5268. Will notify SkyMesh when posted.

Keisha (Accounting): Posted JE and attached supporting docs. Marking FIN-5268 -> "provisional posted".

Luis (Partner Ops): Notifying partner and CS. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:
